resources.string: Locking screen rotation is now supported. The user orientation screen has been removed since locking screen rotation lets you do the same thing. See the instructions in the main screen for details.
Use this app to control screen rotation
Rotation control by this app will be disabled. (You can re-enable it in this app\'s settings screen.) Disable and uninstall this app?

This application needs an accelerometer to run, but it didn\'t find one in this device. If the device does have one, try using the device\'s \"Auto-rotate screen\" option. If that doesn\'t work, the accelerometer might be broken.

Welcome to [Rotation]! This replaces your device\'s screen rotation, so don\'t try to control this app with [the device\'s screen rotation settings](link to display settings).
You can turn auto-rotation on (icon) or off (icons). To see if it\'s on, look at the notification in the notification drawer.
To turn auto-rotation on or off, just touch the notification. You can also make a home screen shortcut %1$sto do this.

When auto-rotation is off, rotating your device will change whether this app thinks you\'re lying down or upright. It thinks you\'re facing the same direction as the screen, so if the screen is facing sideways, this app will think you\'re also sideways. Your position is shown in the notification.\n\nUse this mode when you want to change your position or you don\'t want automatic screen orientation. For example, use this if you\'re upright and you want to lie down.

Automatic screen rotation works the same way as your device\'s screen rotation, except the screen will face you instead of always facing upright. For example, if the app thinks you\'re sideways, the screen will rotate to face sideways.
Some of the apps on your device might control the screen orientation themselves, so this app might not work with them. When this happens, the notification will show this (icons).
To uninstall this, use the menu item on this app\'s main screen so the screen rotation isn\'t left in the wrong state.

If the screen is facing the wrong way:\n 1. Turn the screen off and on again to reset your position to upright.\n 2. Or turn auto-rotation off and rotate your device until the screen is facing the right way.
